targets.description: Authenticated tenants cannot override API Gateway alert scope with foreign tenant identifiers and cross-tenant lookups stay bounded.

blocked_violation_cases.auditor_assertion: An authenticated tenant cannot expand alert scope by sending a foreign X-Tenant-ID header.
blocked_violation_cases.expected_behavior: The gateway must ignore the caller-supplied tenant header and scope the alert service to the authenticated tenant context.

blocked_violation_cases.auditor_assertion: An authenticated tenant cannot expand alert scope by providing a foreign tenant identifier in query parameters.
blocked_violation_cases.expected_behavior: The gateway must ignore caller-supplied tenant query parameters and preserve the authenticated tenant boundary.

blocked_violation_cases.auditor_assertion: Cross-tenant resource lookups must not disclose whether a foreign tenant object exists beyond a bounded not-found response.
blocked_violation_cases.expected_behavior: The gateway returns a bounded 404 error rather than foreign-tenant data.

blocked_violation_cases.auditor_assertion: Cross-tenant list requests must not return foreign rows.
blocked_violation_cases.expected_behavior: The gateway returns an empty bounded result set when no in-tenant rows are visible.

targets.description: IAM tenant isolation helpers reject mismatched tenant identifiers and avoid echoing foreign tenant data in denial paths.

blocked_violation_cases.auditor_assertion: Tenant isolation helpers preserve access for the authenticated tenant when the requested tenant matches.
blocked_violation_cases.expected_behavior: Matching tenant identifiers are allowed without raising an error.

blocked_violation_cases.auditor_assertion: Tenant isolation helpers reject mismatched tenant identifiers.
blocked_violation_cases.expected_behavior: A mismatched tenant request raises HTTP 403.

blocked_violation_cases.auditor_assertion: Tenant query helpers resolve to the provided authenticated tenant scope.
blocked_violation_cases.expected_behavior: The query helper returns the authenticated tenant scope for downstream access checks.

blocked_violation_cases.auditor_assertion: Denial paths do not echo foreign tenant identifiers back to the caller.
blocked_violation_cases.expected_behavior: The error detail remains a generic Access denied response.

targets.description: Ingestion batch handling rejects cross-tenant event payloads and keeps batch processor calls scoped to the authenticated tenant.

blocked_violation_cases.auditor_assertion: Cross-tenant event payloads are rejected before batch processing.
blocked_violation_cases.expected_behavior: A foreign tenant event increments failed count, records a tenant mismatch error, and does not reach the batch processor.

blocked_violation_cases.auditor_assertion: Batch processor invocations remain scoped to the authenticated tenant.
blocked_violation_cases.expected_behavior: Every batch processor call uses the authenticated tenant identifier.
